items.html: And in the world of Yetzirah, the light of Ima of holiness was darkened as well, and only the light of ZA remained there. And this is the secret of 'six Sefirot nest in Metatron,' and the three highest which are in Yetzirah are, as it were, covered in darkness and do not illuminate. And opposite this, a third correction was added in the Klipa of Yetzirah, also in its AA, and light was drawn to it from the AA of Yetzirah of holiness.
